description: AtlasCloud provides unified OpenAI-compatible text inference and native asynchronous media APIs across a broad multi-provider model catalogue.
residency_notes: Atlas Cloud says its services are hosted in the United States and that it forwards requests to underlying model providers. The upstream provider's policy applies to model processing, so Atlas Cloud's US hosting statement is not a single end-to-end execution or residency guarantee and no named ZDR control is documented.
prompt_training_notes: Atlas Cloud says it forwards prompts to underlying model providers and does not store API request content beyond what is needed for billing and troubleshooting.

sources.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat and native asynchronous media endpoint families.
Live official model availability, limits, features, and effective pricing.

verification.notes: OpenAI-compatible text catalogue, model limits, feature flags, and effective prices verified against the live official catalogue; native asynchronous media remains separately capability-gated.
